ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Warcasket
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
WARCASKET_SUIT_CLASS_1. A cross-cutting heavy survival-apparel class, generalized: it names no biome, faction or campaign and is playable standalone on any generated RimWorld planet. Owner ruling, 2026-09-28 (WASTELAND_BEDAZZLE_SITTING_1), verbatim: "Warcaskets REDEFINED cross-cutting: very resistant to extreme temps + vacuum + toxins, an alternative to space suits and ocean access, but very slow, bulky, prone to failure under compound threats — a primitive tank around a person."
RM tier: nothing here knows what campaign or planet uses it. The Wasteland biome (and the frozen Utinni campaign's own Wasteland instance) is this suit's primary use case — Junkers wear a further-adjusted variant to extract fuel from ruined ground — but the suit class itself works anywhere extreme temperature, vacuum or toxic-terrain protection matters: any DLC's space exposure, any biome's toxic fallout, any modded ocean/brine shore.
Ships, all togglable in Mod Settings (defaults = shipped behavior, MOD_OPTIONS_RETROFIT_1 doctrine):
1. RM_Warcasket — the base suit. Real stat coverage for all three hazard classes (extreme-temp Insulation_Cold/Insulation_Heat, vacuum via Odyssey's own VacuumResistance, toxin via Biotech's own ToxicEnvironmentResistance), a heavy MoveSpeed/WorkSpeedGlobal penalty ("very slow, bulky"), and a real compound-failure mechanic: RM_CompWarcasketIntegrity tracks how many hazard classes are simultaneously active against the wearer and rolls a genuine failure chance once two or more stack, damaging the suit and injuring the wearer with a tendable RM_WarcasketBreach hediff — not flavor text, an actual risk that scales with how compound the threat gets and how damaged the suit already is. 2. RM_WarcasketJunker — a Junker-adjusted variant carrying RM_JunkerSarcophagusExtension, a marker+metadata ModExtension a biome's own cast can hook a corpse-interaction onto ("a dead Junker in an adjusted warcasket is a sealed salvage-within-salvage: suit, tools, and the half-extracted core still in its grips" — wasteland.md §7). This mod builds only the suit-side hook; the corpse mechanism itself belongs to whoever owns that biome's cast. 3. Terrain-survival wiring: RM_HazardousTerrainProtection (a summed apparel stat, same shape as this repo's RM_WetBulbProtection) and RM_MapComponent_HazardousTerrainImmersion, a general hazard engine (not warcasket-specific — any apparel granting the stat helps, on any map) that applies RM_TerrainImmersionHazard to a pawn standing on deep/non-walkable water terrain without enough protection. Scoped deliberately to non-walkable ("must swim") water only — an ordinary shallow ford or marsh margin every biome already has pawns cross freely is never the hazard; only water nothing can simply walk across is. 🔴 This is TERRAIN survival only: it grants no dive verb, no MapPortal access, no sea-floor teleport of any kind. A sea FLOOR stays reachable only through a gravship's own RM_SeaDiveHatch — "the ship is the only way down and the only way back" (owner ruling, 2026-09-26). A warcasket lets its wearer stand safely at the edge or wade the shallows and margins of a hostile sea or brine pool; it never lets them dive to, or return from, the floor beneath one.
NOT in this mod: the cask-bay crafting building the sitting approved conceptually, and the Junker corpse-interaction mechanism itself (the loot, the half-extracted core item, the interaction verb) — both are a biome cast's own scope. See WARCASKET_CASK_BAY_AND_SARCOPHAGI_1.
